customManagers.description: The Drydock release whose drydock-objc is the compat guard's strict Objective-C analyzer and whose reference set the shipyard pkg stages as reference/objc (components/drydock/version, a release tag). scripts/fetch_drydock.sh fetches it: the pkg on a Mac, verified against the release's SHA256SUMS, and the Linux archive against components/drydock/linux-sha256, which this manager does not move. A bump must pass tests/objc-guard-test.sh on 10.9 and tests/objc-source-inventory-host-test.sh on a Mac and in the Linux job.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves .mavergreen/ingredients/clang22/VERSION and components/objc-receipt-clang/version but cannot write the Linux archive's digest beside either, so the Linux job fails on the bump until .mavergreen/ingredients/clang22/LINUX_SHA256 and components/objc-receipt-clang/linux-sha256 name the new release's archive.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, write the digest of `clang22-<version>-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` from the new release's SHA256SUMS, alone, to .mavergreen/ingredients/clang22/LINUX_SHA256: `gh release download <version> -R Mavergreen/clang-22 -p SHA256SUMS -O - | awk '$2 ~ /linux-x86_64[.]tar[.]gz$/ { print $1 }' > .mavergreen/ingredients/clang22/LINUX_SHA256`. Also replace components/objc-receipt-clang/linux-sha256 with that archive's line of SHA256SUMS; an objc-receipt-clang bump must also pass tests/objc-source-inventory-host-test.sh on Linux and a Mac.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves components/drydock/version but cannot write the Linux archive's digest beside it, so the Linux job fails on the bump until components/drydock/linux-sha256 names the new release's archive.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, replace components/drydock/linux-sha256 with the `drydock-<version without v>-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` line of the new release's SHA256SUMS: `gh release download <tag> -R Mavergreen/drydock -p SHA256SUMS -O - | grep linux-x86_64.tar.gz > components/drydock/linux-sha256`. Also rewrite tests/fixtures/objc-api/provider-body.tool with the new release's receipt tool digest (the `tools/objc-source-inventory.c` line of Drydock's tests/objc/IMPORTED.sha256 at the new tag). The bump must pass tests/objc-guard-test.sh on 10.9 (its report's analyzer names the new release) and tests/objc-source-inventory-host-test.sh on a Mac and in the Linux job.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves the commit in .mavergreen/ingredients/mulle-xcode-to-cmake/PIN but cannot write SHA256 beside it, so the host-tool build refuses the bump until that digest names GitHub's tarball of the new commit, checked against the commit's tree.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, write to .mavergreen/ingredients/mulle-xcode-to-cmake/SHA256, alone, the SHA-256 of `https://codeload.github.com/mulle-nat/mulle-xcode-to-cmake/tar.gz/<new commit>`, after checking that the tarball's files are that commit's tree (`git archive` of the commit compared with the extracted tarball).

packageRules.description: The renovate pin moves at most monthly: each bump costs macOS runner time in shipyard's CI and then its release, and the validator gains nothing from tracking Renovate's every release.
schedule: on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: linux-host.yml's setup-node runs Renovate's own config validator, whose package requires node ^24.11.0, so node stays on 24 until a renovate pin needs another major.
